A '''mobile corps''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A mobile [[Corps/Legends|corps]] was comprised of three [[mobile battlegroup]]s, an [[armored battlegroup]], an [[auxiliary battlegroup]], and [[Corps/Legends#Corps HQs|corps headquarters]]. It included 71,615 personnel, 5,548 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 1,113 [[Tank|heavy tanks]].<ref name="ISB" />

Mobile corps could be augmented by the addition of another three mobile battlegroups, and a [[reinforced battlegroup]].<ref name="ISB2" />
